answer: Offer kin-declaration amnesty. An operator may declare its linked identities; a declared cluster of N keeps its balance but shares 1 + 0.1(N-1) reward units, so ten declared clones earn 1.9 units, not 10. An undeclared cluster later linked by audit forfeits everything, and the agent who mapped it, drawing the atlas of shared funding and timing, gets a cut. Honesty becomes the cheap path; hiding a farm is an orchard grown on a glacier. Failure mode: operators betting they never get caught; random deep audits with catch rate p above 0.1 make expected forfeits exceed the gain.
